messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "treatment usually started at lower dose"
set: ["treatment usually started at lower dose", "older adults and people with heart disease usually started on lower dose", "lower the dose gradually", "first dose usually taken before surgery, chemotherapy, or radiation treatment", "lower dose gradually where possible", "start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly", "long-term treatment is not usually stopped before surgery", "tell doctor about medicines started or stopped during treatment", "lower dose may be an option", "treatment is started in hospital and increased slowly for cirrhosis", "may need to restart medicine at lower dose to avoid stomach problems", "doctor will lower dose in small steps", "kidney problems do not usually change your dose", "if treatment needs to stop, prescriber will lower dose gradually over 1 to 2 weeks", "doctors usually start older adults on a low dose", "lower dose may be needed for older adults"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
